Whenever I try to pronounce Ra, the sound of Waw comes out. I have tried a lot of time when I was small, and when I was doing Hifz but it did not improve. Now since I am a Hafiz, I am usually asked to lead the prayer when the Imam is not present in the Masjid. I want to ask whether it is ok if I lead the prayer? I cannot even pronounce Allahu Akbar properly. The sound comes out as Allahu Akbaw, but people usually don't notice. And then there will be many more mistakes in Surah Fatihah. So is my prayer valid? And what about the prayer of those who are praying behind me? I heard one 'Alim say that if Takbeere Tahreema is not proper, then a person will not even enter into the prayer. It is as if he has not started the prayer at all. What should I do then? I cannot pronounce it properly. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160425 Country: India Title: Can I perform namaz on sitting position during traveling in train, bus, flight? Question: Can I perform namaz on sitting position during traveling in train, bus, flight? Answer ID: 160425 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 864/725/SN=8/1439) No, if you have even least chance to offer salah standing then it is mandatory to offer salah by standing in train and flight as qiyam will not drop. Note: The answer is correct, but if you offer salah in the bus or flight sitting due to some reason then you will have to offer the salah again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
